0.headline: Five drafts, zero points, one hundred fourteen up for grabs
0.overview: Pre-season, and the scoreboard is a beautiful blank slate: five drafts, zero points apiece, every castaway still breathing, and 114 on the table for all of them. Tami, drafting first in the snake, opened with Jelly at #1 and stacked five bodies including the leftover Sharonda at #21, though only her best four count. Taylor grabbed Kristin at #2, Kylie took Aaliyah at #3, Tim scooped Lewis at #4, and Austin, picking last, doubled up immediately with Linnea and Jenna at #5 and #6. Different shapes, identical starting line. Let's see whose blueprint holds.

lines.text: Austin sat at the back of the snake and cashed in with back-to-back picks Linnea and Jenna, then closed with Carter and Eric for a 4-of-4 roster nobody can call thin.

Kylie's "Chef, Counsel & Chaos" runs Aaliyah at #3, Cristian, Alexis and Kilby — a chef, an HR head, a defense attorney and a game designer, which sounds less like a tribe and more like a hostage negotiation.
Tami used the first overall pick on Jelly and then quietly hoarded five castaways through Rob at #20 and Sharonda at #21, knowing only her best four will ever count.
Taylor went crisis management at #2 with Kristin, 49, then layered in Ori, Ana and Brady the pro wrestler — chokeslams and voice acting, all still in.
Tim took Lewis at #4 and Maggie at #7 — two farmers, no apologies — then balanced the barn with Devin and Thien An.

awards.label: Boldest draft
awards.text: Tami is carrying five castaways when only four score, betting that depth beats precision.

awards.label: Safest draft
awards.text: Tim built "Two Farmers and a Bus" on Lewis, Maggie, Devin and Thien An — no gimmicks, all four still in.

1.headline: Four tied at the top, one torch already snuffed
1.overview: One episode in and the board is bunched tighter than a Toka shelter: Austin, Tami, Taylor and Tim are all deadlocked at 4 points, all rosters fully intact, all staring at 110 on the table. Tami's got the numbers game — five bodies, best four counting, plus an Idol Whisperer badge. Austin and Tim share the best draft GPA at 3.75, Tami's at 3.6, Taylor 3.5. And then there's Kylie, sitting fifth at 3 points with a 3 GPA, 3 of 4 still in, 85 on the table, and the First Blood badge nobody wants. Twenty remain. Game on, family.

lines.text: Cattle, Cameras & Counseling is perfect through one night, and that late steal of Eric at #16 already grades out as a rank 1 — a 3.75 GPA says Austin did his homework.
The Idol Whisperers have five castaways breathing, the leftover pick Sharonda at #21 grading as a rank 1 steal, and a badge on the wall — that's depth, family.
Voice, Muscle & Mischief got exactly what the team name promised when Brady, the #19 pick and a rank 1 steal, made it his personal mission at Toka.
Two Farmers and a Bus is rolling untouched at 4 points with a 3.75 GPA, and Thien An at #17 grading out rank 1 is the kind of value that wins seasons.
Chaos and Counsel caught the first torch snuff when Aaliyah — the #3 pick that grades as a rank 21 reach — went out first, but Kilby at #18 is a rank 1 steal and 85 is still very much on the table.

awards.label: Draft of the week
awards.text: Five castaways standing, only the best four counting, and a leftover pick grading as a rank 1 steal — Tami built herself a cushion before anyone else even noticed.

awards.label: Ouch of the week
awards.text: Drafting Aaliyah at #3 and watching her torch get snuffed first is the harshest welcome this game hands out.

2.headline: Three-way tie at the top, Toka's farmhands untouched
2.overview: Two episodes in and we have a traffic jam at the top: Austin, Tami and Tim all sit on 8 pts with 106 on the table, and all three added +4 this episode. Austin and Tim sport identical 3.75 draft GPAs; Tami counters with 5 of 5 still breathing and an Idol Whisperer badge, even if only her best 4 count. Taylor sits fourth at 7 pts, 3 of 4 alive, 82 on the table after losing Ana. Kylie trails at 6 pts with the same 82 available, First Blood badge and all.

lines.text: Four for four, a 3.75 GPA, and Eric at #16 turning into a rank-1 steal — Austin's 'Livestock and Lovebirds' is quietly flawless.
Tami's the only one with 5 of 5 still in the game, and leftover pick #21 Sharonda already grades out as a rank-1 steal — that's the Idol Whisperer touch.
An all-Toka roster on the night Toka wins immunity? Tim's 'Farmhands' got the easiest +4 of the week, with Thien An at #17 as the rank-1 steal.
Brady at #19 is a rank-1 steal, but Ana at #12 graded out as rank 20 and became the 2nd person voted out — that's the 2.5 GPA talking.
First Blood is a badge nobody wants: Aaliyah went first at 0 pts, Kylie's 3-of-4 roster sits at 6 pts, and Kilby at #18 is the lifeline.

awards.label: Draft of the week
awards.text: Loading up on Toka and watching Toka take immunity is the kind of draft night that pays its own bills.

awards.label: Ouch of the week
awards.text: Ana at pick #12 graded as rank 20 and left the game second — the only roster to take a hit tonight.
